thread:
Alex: FYI – PR #12411 (model-sharding) needs to land before maintenance at 22:00 UTC. CI is queued, asking for a rebase slot or CI priority. Any objections?
Maria: Is this blocking a user-visible release or just infra perf? If it's infra we can aim for next dedicated window but pre-freeze may be tricky.
Jamal: What's the current CI status? Any flaky tests?
Alex: There's one unrelated flake on integration/streaming-timeout, likely harmless. Full run started at https://ci.redwood.internal/12411
sre-bot: CI status: queued (position 4). Estimated start ~35m.
Cate: Maintenance window starts 22:00 UTC? We have a pre-freeze rebase window 20:30–21:15. If we miss that, merges get blocked until 01:00.
Alex: Ok I can rebase now. Will push a short patch to tighten the timeout. ETA 15m.
Jamal: I can give fast approval once tests pass; ping me after you rebase.
Maria: Heads-up — if we reroute to the dedicated CI cluster we can get priority runs, but will need SRE to approve. @sre-bot can you escalate?
sre-bot: Escalation request submitted. Priority slot available in ~12m if submitted with reason "pre-freeze hotfix". Use `/ci priority <pr>` to request.
Alex: running `/ci priority 12411` — output: accepted, slot allocated. Kicking rebuild.
sre-bot: CI status: running (job 3/10).
Cate: tagging @Jamal @Maria for final review — please quick-look. If green I'll merge in the 20:45 rebase window.
Jamal: Quick LGTM on code changes. Two minor nits inline, not blocking.
Maria: Reviewed, one comment about logging, not blocking.
Alex: Tests passed ✅. Merging into main now. Thanks all.
Cate: Thanks — monitor prod for 30m after deploy. I'll queue a rollback plan in case. :thumbsup:
Jamal: noted, I'll watch alerts.
sre-bot: Deploy started to canary at 21:02 UTC. Canary healthy after 5m.
Alex: Closing loop — landed PR #12411 at 21:06 UTC, no regressions so far.
